name: KTBST Mixed Freehold and Leasehold Real Estate Investment Trust
summary: KTBST Mixed Freehold and Leasehold Real Estate Investment Trust functions as a real estate investment trust, primarily channeling its capital into a diverse range of property development ventures throughout Thailand. This trust possesses entitlements to lease and sub-lease various types of real estate, including land parcels, industrial facilities (such as warehouses and factories), commercial office spaces, and community retail centers. It commenced operations in 2021 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
